gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold: headaches. Gen cc-002: 'severe headaches.' Same complaint, severity detail added but consistent.
Gold: loss of appetite. Gen cc-005: 'decreased appetite.' Same concept.
Gold: tingling sensations. Gen cc-003: 'intermittent tingling in both arms.' Same core complaint with added laterality/frequency.
Gold: feels hot/fevers. Gen cc-001: 'feeling hot.' Matches the complaint of feeling hot.
Gold: palpitations. Gen cc-004: 'Patient reports palpitations.' Matches.

Gold: symptoms began after starting a new high-stress job as a lawyer working at a computer. Gen hpi-001: 'after a job change to a new law firm' and SH shows lawyer and high stress. Same underlying timing and job-change trigger; computer detail omitted but not contradicted.
Gold: frontal headaches. Gen hpi-002: 'located at the front of the head.' Same location.
Gold: headaches occur without a pre-aura. No generated fact addresses presence/absence of aura.
Gold: headaches do not radiate. No generated fact discusses radiation of headache pain.
Gold: headaches associated with some nausea. Gen hpi-003: 'sometimes associated with mild nausea.' Same idea.
Gold: denies vomiting with headaches. No generated fact mentions vomiting or its absence.
Gold: no prior medical history of headaches. No generated fact addresses prior headache history.
Gold: headaches accompanied by fevers. No generated HPI fact relates fevers/feeling hot to headaches specifically.

Gold: reduced appetite with 5-lb unintentional weight loss. Gen hpi-007 mentions unintentional 5-lb weight loss; cc-005 and asm-004 reference decreased appetite. Combined, the same information is captured.
Gold: pins and needles in both arms, no radiation to legs. Gen hpi-004: 'tingling in both arms (prickling), no leg involvement.' Equivalent.
Gold: maintains motor and sensory function, no loss of function. No generated fact comments on preserved motor/sensory function.
Gold: palpitations with mild SOB on exertion and at rest. Gen hpi-006: SOB at desk not on exertion—this differs, not covers. No gen fact reproduces the gold association/pattern.
Gold: symptoms occur at random times at work, sometimes together/individually, no presymptoms. No generated fact addresses temporal randomness, clustering, or presymptoms.
Gold: acute onset. No generated fact describes the onset pattern as acute.
Gold: hypothyroidism. Gen pmh-001: same diagnosis.
Gold: taking Thyroxine. Gen med-001: taking thyroxine and adherent; same medication with extra adherence detail.
Gold: no known drug allergies. Gen allergy-001: NKDA. Same.
Gold: works as a lawyer. Gen sh-001: lawyer in London. Same occupation.
Gold: stressful job. Gen sh-002: high work stress 7–8/10. Same concept with quantified detail.
Gold: drinks alcohol. Gen sh-003: drinks alcohol once per week, 1–2 glasses. Same behavior with more detail.

Gold: differential includes hypothyroidism (questioned). Gen asm-006: hypothyroidism stable on thyroxine as a known condition, not listed as a DDx. Different assessment; the specific 'DDx ??hypothyroid?' is not reflected.
Gold: perform further physical examination. Gen plan-001: arrange in-person review for physical exam; plan-003: cardiac and respiratory exam. The need for further exam is clearly included.
Gold: order blood tests. Gen plan-002: blood tests including thyroid function. Same with added specificity.
